highlights: 【Active Noise Cancellation】Adopting hybrid active noise cancellation technology with a 10mm high amplitude audio controller, HAYLOU MoriPods ANC wireless headphones deliver intense treble and powerful bass with noise reduction, helping you maintain your focus wherever you are. (ANC mode, transparency mode, Normal mode can be changed freely).

【Immersive and premium sound】 with a 10mm high amplitude audio AAC controller to create the most impactful music experience. It's like being in front of the artists, or being with them in the studio or on stage, getting “closer to music.” You have to listen to it to believe it.

【Bluetooth 5.2 technology and low latency】 MoriPods ANC wireless Bluetooth headphones perfectly fit iPhone Android tablets, laptops and smartphones. The latest Bluetooth 5.2 chip has significantly improved Bluetooth headset issues such as disconnection, game crashes and other issues. The left and right dual host ensures a stable connection every second.

【37 hours playback time and C-type charging】Lightweight body but great energy. The bluetooth headphones can be used for about 7.5 hours on a single full charge, and the battery life can be up to 30 hours with the charging box, allowing you to enjoy a long-lasting immersion. Only one type C cable for business trips.

【One-Step Pairing】After connecting your devices for the first time, take the two headphones from the charging case and they will be paired automatically. Then simply enable the bluetooth connection on your mobile phone to pair the device with your headphones.
